objective.subject: test: pin timeout-action thread retirement at quiescence
objective.body:
Focused PIT on ParRuntime* after the removal left one survivor that the
2026-11-24 batch-D record reported KILLED: deleting
timeoutActionPool.shutdown() in shutdownServicesWhenAdmissionsComplete.
That record's killer, ParRuntimeTest.closingTheInstalledInstanceReleasesTheGlobalSlot,
cannot observe pool shutdown, and base-commit runs restricted to
ParRuntimeTest or to the deleted ThreadPoolStarvationObservationScopeTest
both leave the mutant SURVIVED, so the earlier kill was incidental and no
test asserted the behavior.

quiescenceRetiresTheTimeoutActionThreads runs one action on the runtime's
timeout-action pool, closes the runtime, waits for quiescence, and then
requires that the action thread has exited and that the pool refuses new
actions (awaitQuiescence: "the framework-owned services have shut down";
releases(): "rejects work after the runtime's services shut down").

Reverse verification: with timeoutActionPool.shutdown() removed the test
fails ("the timeout-action thread outlived quiescence"); with it restored
the test passes.
